cases.name: 1976 Tehran UFO incident
cases.description: 19 September 1976 radar and visual sighting of an unidentified object over Tehran, Iran, during which two Imperial Iranian Air Force F-4 interceptors reported instrument and communications failures.

cases.name: 1984 Hudson Valley UFO sightings
cases.description: Wave of UFO reports in 1983-1984 across the Hudson Valley of New York and western Connecticut, attributed by state police to light planes flying in formation.

cases.name: 2006 O'Hare International Airport UFO sighting
cases.description: 7 November 2006 report by United Airlines employees of a metallic, saucer-shaped object hovering over Gate C-17 at Chicago O'Hare International Airport.

cases.name: Antônio Vilas-Boas
cases.description: 1957 claim by Brazilian farmer Antônio Vilas-Boas that he was taken aboard a landed craft by humanoids near São Francisco de Sales.

cases.name: Ariel School UFO incident
cases.description: 16 September 1994 report by 62 pupils of Ariel School near Ruwa, Zimbabwe, of silver objects landing beside the school and beings dressed in black.

cases.name: Aztec crashed saucer hoax
cases.description: Allegation that a flying saucer crashed near Aztec, New Mexico in 1948, exposed in 1952 as a hoax by two con men.

cases.name: Cash–Landrum incident
cases.description: 29 December 1980 report by Betty Cash, Vickie Landrum and Colby Landrum of a flame-emitting diamond-shaped object and helicopters near Dayton, Texas, followed by health claims and a dismissed lawsuit.

cases.name: Chiles-Whitted UFO encounter
cases.description: July 24, 1948 sighting by two Eastern Air Lines pilots of a glowing object near Montgomery, Alabama, later attributed to a meteor.

cases.name: Disappearance of Frederick Valentich
cases.description: 1978 disappearance of an Australian pilot over Bass Strait after he radioed that an unidentified aircraft was accompanying him.

cases.name: Exeter incident
cases.description: UFO sighting on September 3, 1965 in Kensington near Exeter, New Hampshire, by a teenager and two police officers.

cases.name: Falcon Lake Incident
cases.description: Alleged UFO encounter on 20 May 1967 at Falcon Lake, Manitoba, in which lone witness Steve Michalak claimed he was burned by a landed craft's exhaust.

cases.name: Felix Moncla
cases.description: 23 November 1953 disappearance of USAF pilot Felix Moncla and his F-89C Scorpion over Lake Superior while intercepting an unidentified radar target.

cases.name: Flatwoods monster
cases.description: Alleged humanoid reported by a group of local residents in Flatwoods, West Virginia, on September 12, 1952 after a bright light crossed the night sky.

cases.name: Gorman dogfight
cases.description: 1 October 1948 incident in which National Guard pilot George F. Gorman chased a blinking ball of light over Fargo, North Dakota.

cases.name: Japan Air Lines Cargo Flight 1628
cases.description: 17 November 1986 UFO sighting reported by the captain of a Japan Air Lines Boeing 747-200 cargo flight over eastern Alaska.

cases.name: Kaikōura lights
cases.description: Series of UFO sightings in December 1978 above the Kaikōura mountain ranges, New Zealand, including lights filmed from a Safe Air cargo plane.

cases.name: Kecksburg UFO incident
cases.description: 9 December 1965 fireball seen over six U.S. states and Canada, with claims that an object crashed in woods at Kecksburg, Pennsylvania.

cases.name: Kelly–Hopkinsville encounter
cases.description: Claimed 1955 close encounter in which a Kentucky farm family said small creatures from a spaceship besieged their farmhouse.

cases.name: Kenneth Arnold UFO sighting
cases.description: 24 June 1947 sighting by private pilot Kenneth Arnold of nine shiny objects flying past Mount Rainier, Washington, which gave rise to the term 'flying saucer'.

cases.name: Lakenheath-Bentwaters incident
cases.description: Series of radar and visual contacts with unidentified objects over airbases in eastern England on the night of 13-14 August 1956.

cases.name: Mantell UFO incident
cases.description: 7 January 1948 fatal crash of Kentucky Air National Guard pilot Thomas F. Mantell while pursuing an unidentified flying object over Kentucky.
